name: The Last of Us Part I
native_kbm_note: PS5 version has no keyboard/mouse gameplay support; KBM controls were added only in the PC port (Naughty Dog/Iron Galaxy). No source lists KBM support on PS5.
notes: PC MOUSE1 does reload/quick throw/use when not aiming and fire while aiming; both are R2 on PS5, so it maps cleanly (R is a secondary reload key on PC). E = interact (TRIANGLE); on PC E is also scope while aiming, which is CROSS on PS5 (not reproduced). TAB = backpack (TOUCHPAD; B is a secondary key); on PC TAB is also shoulder swap while aiming, which is SQUARE on PS5 (not reproduced). Mouse wheel cycles the weapon cross (gameskinny pairs it with D-pad up/left and down/right); mapped to D-pad left/right for weapons. Key 7 (health kit) mapped to D-pad up (health kit is on D-pad up per n4g). Other number slots (1-6, 8, 9), crafting from the wheel (SPACE), slow walk (LCTRL), shake flashlight (J, motion on PS5) have no single PS5 button equivalent and are omitted.
